'''Caroline Spinola''' is a voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is currently affiliated with Stewart Talent Agency in New York and MCVO Agency in Boston.

==Biography==
Little is known about Spinola's life, other than she became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where she voiced recurring character [[Ida]]. In addition to her role of Ida, Spinola also voiced [[Noah]] & a [[Team Twin Starmie]] member, and went on to voice [[Hohma]] in [[Pokémon: Paldean Winds|Paldean Winds]].
